cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, random
rng=random.Random(3)
cases=[]
for c in range(8):
    S=256; J=128; F=32; G=32
    times=[s*(1000+c) for s in range(S)]
    groups=[]
    for g in range(G):
        parent=-1 if g<3 else rng.choice([-1,g-1,rng.randint(0,g-1)])
        groups.append([parent,rng.choice([5,30,512])])
    flows=[]
    for f in range(F):
        flows.append([rng.choice([1,4,16,64]), rng.choice([4,16,512]), -1 if rng.random()<0.3 else rng.randint(0,G-1), rng.randint(0,6)])
    for f in range(F):
        if flows[f][1]<flows[f][0]: flows[f][1]=flows[f][0]
    windows=[]
    for j in range(J):
        f=rng.randint(0,F-1)
        ready=rng.randint(0,times[-1])
        expires=rng.randint(ready,times[-1])
        windows.append([f,ready,expires,rng.choice([1,3277,65535]),rng.choice([1,100,320]),0,rng.randint(1,1000),
                        [[rng.randint(0,1500),rng.randint(0,2560)] for _ in range(9)]])
    cases.append({'model':rng.choice(['cnn','rnn']),'class_values':[rng.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],
      'stats':[rng.choice([100,7,10**6]),rng.choice([100000,3,10**9]),rng.choice([1000000,75,1])],
      'bucket':[rng.choice([9,512]),rng.choice([0,4,512])],
      'slots':[[times[s],rng.choice([1,2,3,512]),0 if s==0 else rng.choice([0,1,2,512])] for s in range(S)],
      'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':windows})
json.dump({'version':3,'cases':cases},open('/workspace/tmp/batch8.json','w'))
print('ok')
PYEOF
ls -la /workspace/tmp/batch8.json; cd /workspace && time (python3 public_exec.py /workspace/submission/main.py < /workspace/tmp/batch8.json > /workspace/tmp/batch8.out 2>/workspace/tmp/batch8.err; echo exit=$?); ls -la /workspace/tmp/batch8.out; python3 -c "

"; head -c 300 /workspace/tmp/batch8.err
